title: Story premise EDU106: The Wet Floor Warning Needs a Route
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (public safety/preparedness). Hook: Can the warning be seen before the choice is made? Takeaway/theme: A warning should be evaluated from the user’s actual approach and available choices.
description: A facility team wants people to notice a temporary walking hazard, but a lone sign appears too late in the fictional approach. A reviewed plan considers visibility and an accessible alternative without asking viewers to step through the hazard.
